core_result: Historical snapshot (superseded by 0TH-2026-009). Formalizes in Lean a finite-tree Ville bound and the sharp 1−β classical cap for the Peres–Mermin square, plus a 36-round counterexample (> 4.3% false crossing); an exact Python calculation gives 97.24% vs 0.89% false rejection at 1,000 trials.
verification_boundary: Adaptive-tree evidence bound, biased-setting classical cap (11/12), and a 36-round counterexample (> 4.3% false crossing) are formally verified in Lean 4; the 1,000-trial rates are exact Python calculations; paired with reproducible Moonlab/QGTL/QRNG/Eshkol simulation. Explicitly disclaims hardware contextuality or certified randomness. Superseded GitHub repository archived read-only on 2026-11-24 and consolidated into 0TH-2026-009 (0thernes/pauli-contextuality-lab); this historical snapshot remains cryptographically pinned.
